# E-Commerce Shopping Mall Platform

## Customer Account

- This platform requires registration to use any features (no guest browsing)
- Customers sign up with email and password
- Customers log in with email and password
- Customers can change their password
- Customers can delete their account
- When a customer deletes their account:
  - Their profile information is deleted
  - Their orders and order history are preserved (for seller records and legal purposes)
  - Their reviews are preserved but shown as "deleted user"

## Customer Profile

- Each customer has a profile with: display name and phone number
- Customers can edit their display name and phone number

## Address Management

- Customers can add multiple shipping addresses
- Each address has: recipient name, phone number, street address, city, state/province, postal code, country
- Customers can edit their addresses
- Customers can delete their addresses
- Customers can set one address as the default shipping address

## Seller Account

- Sellers sign up with email and password
- Sellers log in with email and password
- Sellers can change their password
- Seller accounts require administrator approval before they can sell
- Sellers can view their approval status (pending, approved, rejected)
- If rejected, sellers can view the rejection reason
- Rejected sellers can submit a new registration request
- Sellers can delete their account only if:
  - They have no pending orders (paid or shipped status)
  - They have no pending cancellation or refund requests
- When a seller deletes their account:
  - Their products are deleted from listings
  - Order history and snapshots are preserved
  - Their shop name in past orders is preserved

## Seller Profile

- Each seller has a profile with: shop name, shop description, and logo image
- Sellers can edit their shop name, description, and logo
- Every edit creates a snapshot
- Customers can view seller profiles

## Categories

- Products are organized into categories
- Categories can have subcategories (one level of nesting only)
- Each category has: name and description
- Categories are created and managed by administrators only
- Customers can browse the list of all categories
- Customers can view products within a category

## Snapshot Principle

- This is a platform where money is exchanged, so all data modifications must be recorded
- Whenever editable data is modified, a snapshot is created to preserve the previous state
- Snapshots record: when the change was made, what was changed, and the values before and after
- Snapshots are immutable and cannot be deleted
- Snapshots can be viewed by relevant parties (owners, administrators) for dispute resolution

**Product Snapshot Structure**
- When a product is edited, a product snapshot is created
- The product snapshot includes all product fields (name, description, category, base price, images)
- The product snapshot also includes snapshots of all variants at that moment (product-snapshot  product-snapshot-SKU)
- This preserves the complete state of a product and its variants at any point in time

**Snapshot applies to:**
- Products (all fields including images)
- Product variants (SKU code, option values, price)
- Seller profiles (shop name, description, logo)
- Order items (product, variant, and seller profile at time of purchase)
- Reviews (rating, text content)
- Cancellation requests (reason, status changes)
- Refund requests (reason, status changes)

## Products

- Sellers can create products
- Every product has:
  - Name (required)
  - Description (required)
  - Category (required, can select a subcategory)
  - Base price (required)
- Products belong to the seller who created them
- Sellers can edit their own products
- Every edit creates a snapshot
- Sellers can delete their own products only if:
  - There are no pending order items (paid or shipped status) for any variant of the product
  - There are no pending cancellation or refund requests for any variant of the product
- Deleting a product also deletes all its variants and inventory records
- Deleted products no longer appear in search or category listings
- Sellers can view snapshots of their own products
- Administrators can view snapshots of any product
- Snapshots are preserved even after product deletion

## Product Images

- Sellers can upload multiple images for each product
- Images can be reordered (first image is the main/thumbnail image)
- Sellers can delete images from their products
- Image changes are included in product snapshots

## Product Variants (SKU)

- A product can have multiple variants
- Each variant represents a specific combination of options (e.g., "Red / Large", "Blue / Small")
- Each variant has:
  - SKU code (unique identifier, required)
  - Option values (e.g., color: "Red", size: "Large")
  - Price (can override the base price, optional)
  - Stock quantity (required, starts at 0)
- Sellers can add variants to their products
- Sellers can edit variants (SKU code, option values, price)
- Every variant edit creates a snapshot
- Sellers can delete variants only if:
  - There are no pending order items (paid or shipped status) for that variant
  - There are no pending cancellation or refund requests for that variant
- A product must have at least one variant to be purchasable
- Products with no variants are visible in search but shown as "unavailable"

## Inventory Management

- Each variant has its own stock quantity
- Stock quantity is managed through inventory history records (not snapshots)
- Each inventory record contains: quantity change (positive for restocking, negative for orders/adjustments), reason, and timestamp
- Current stock is calculated by summing all inventory records
- Sellers can add inventory (restock) with a quantity and reason
- Sellers can subtract inventory (adjustment/loss) with a quantity and reason
- Order placement automatically creates a negative inventory record
- Order cancellation/refund automatically creates a positive inventory record
- Sellers can view the full inventory history of each variant
- When stock reaches 0, the variant is shown as "out of stock"
- Out of stock variants cannot be added to cart

## Product Search

- Customers can search products by name
- Search results show products from all sellers
- Search results are paginated
- Customers can filter search results by:
  - Category
  - Price range (minimum and maximum)
  - In-stock only
- Customers can sort search results by:
  - Newest first
  - Price (low to high)
  - Price (high to low)

## Product Listing

- When viewing a list of products (search results, category page), each product shows:
  - Main image (thumbnail)
  - Name
  - Base price (or price range if variants have different prices)
  - Seller shop name
  - Average rating (if reviews exist)

## Product Detail Page

- Customers can view a single product's full details
- The page shows:
  - All images
  - Name and description
  - Category
  - Seller shop name (links to seller profile)
  - All available variants with prices and stock status
  - Average rating and total review count
  - All reviews

## Wishlist

- Customers can add products to their wishlist
- Customers can view their wishlist
- The wishlist is paginated
- Wishlist shows products (not specific variants)
- Customers can remove products from their wishlist
- If a product is deleted by the seller, it is automatically removed from all wishlists

## Shopping Cart

- Customers can add variants to their cart (must select a specific variant, not just a product)
- When adding to cart, customers specify the quantity
- If the same variant is already in the cart, the quantities are combined (not added as a separate line)
- Customers can view their cart
- Cart shows each item with: product name, variant options, price, quantity, and subtotal
- Customers can change the quantity of items in their cart
- Customers can remove items from their cart
- Cart shows the total price of all items
- If a variant's stock is less than the cart quantity, a warning is shown
- If a variant is deleted or out of stock, it is marked as unavailable in the cart

## Checkout

- Customers can proceed to checkout from their cart
- Unavailable items cannot be checked out
- Customers must select a shipping address (or use default)
- Customers can review the order summary before placing the order:
  - List of items with prices
  - Shipping address
  - Total price
- Once an order is placed, the shipping address cannot be changed

## Payment

- After reviewing, customers confirm and place the order
- Payment is processed (assume external payment gateway integration)
- Payment can succeed or fail
- If payment fails, the order is not created and customers can retry
- If payment succeeds, the order is created

## Order Creation

- When an order is placed successfully:
  - Stock quantities are decreased for each purchased variant
  - Items are removed from the customer's cart
  - An order record is created
  - Each purchased variant becomes an order item with status "paid"
  - A snapshot of each purchased product and variant is saved with the order item (preserves product name, description, variant options, and price at the time of purchase)
  - A snapshot of each seller's profile is saved with the order item (preserves shop name and logo at the time of purchase)

## Order Structure

- An order contains one or more order items
- Each order item represents a purchased product variant with a quantity
- If a customer buys 3 of the same variant, it becomes one order item with quantity 3
- Order items can be from different sellers
- Each order item has its own status
- Each order item can be individually cancelled or refunded
- Order items are grouped into shipments when shipped (see Shipping and Tracking)

## Order History

- Customers can view a list of all their orders
- The list is paginated and sorted by newest first
- Each order in the list shows: order number, date, total price, and overall order status
- Customers can view the full details of an order:
  - List of items with: product name, variant, quantity, price, and item status
  - Shipping address
  - List of shipments with tracking information (each shipment shows which items are included)

## Order Status

**Order Item Status**
- Each item in an order has its own status
- Item statuses:
  - Paid: payment completed, waiting for seller to ship
  - Shipped: seller has shipped the item
  - Delivered: item has been delivered
  - Cancelled: item was cancelled
  - Refunded: item was refunded

**Order Status**
- The overall order status is derived from its items
- If all items are paid  order is "paid"
- If any item is shipped (and none delivered yet)  order is "shipped"
- If all items are delivered  order is "delivered"
- If all items are cancelled  order is "cancelled"
- If all items are refunded  order is "refunded"
- Mixed states (e.g., some delivered, some refunded)  order is "partially completed"

## Shipping and Tracking

**Shipment Concept**
- A shipment is a package sent by a seller
- A shipment can contain one or more order items from the same seller
- Different sellers always ship separately (different shipments)
- A seller can choose to ship items individually or bundle multiple items into one shipment

**Shipping Process**
- Sellers can view order items for their products that need shipping
- When shipping, sellers select one or more of their items to include in a shipment
- Sellers enter tracking information for the shipment (carrier name, tracking number)
- All items in the same shipment share the same tracking information
- When a shipment is created, all items in it change to status "shipped"

**Delivery Confirmation**
- Customers can view tracking information for each shipment
- Customers confirm delivery per shipment (not per item)
- When the customer confirms delivery, all items in that shipment change to status "delivered"
- If the customer does not confirm, items automatically change to "delivered" after 14 days from shipping

## Order Cancellation

- Cancellation is handled per order item, not per entire order
- Customers can request cancellation for individual items with status "paid" (not yet shipped)
- Cancellation requests include a reason (text)
- The seller of that item can approve or reject the cancellation request
- When a seller responds, a snapshot of the request state is created
- If approved, that item is cancelled and refund is processed for that item only
- Cancelled items restore their stock quantities (via inventory record)
- The remaining items in the order continue processing normally
- If all items in an order are cancelled, the entire order status becomes "cancelled"

## Refund Requests

- Refund is handled per order item, not per entire order
- Customers can request a refund for individual items with status "delivered"
- Refund requests include a reason (text)
- Refund can be requested within 7 days of that item being delivered
- The seller of that item can approve or reject the refund request
- When a seller responds, a snapshot of the request state is created
- If approved, that item is refunded
- Refunded items restore their stock quantities (via inventory record)
- The remaining items in the order are unaffected
- If all items in an order are refunded, the entire order status becomes "refunded"

## Reviews and Ratings

- Customers can write a review for products they have purchased
- A review can only be written after that item's status is "delivered"
- Customers can write one review per product per order
- Each review has:
  - Rating (1 to 5 stars, required)
  - Text content (optional)
- Reviews are displayed on the product detail page
- Reviews are sorted by newest first
- Customers can edit their own reviews
- Every review edit creates a snapshot
- Customers can delete their own reviews (but snapshots are preserved)
- Product's average rating is calculated from all non-deleted reviews

## Seller Dashboard

- Sellers can view a summary of their shop:
  - Total number of products
  - Total number of order items (for their products)
  - Number of pending cancellation requests
  - Number of pending refund requests
- Sellers can view a list of all order items for their products
- Sellers can filter order items by status

## Administrator System

**Becoming an Administrator**
- Any user (customer or seller) can submit a request to become an administrator
- The request includes a reason (text)
- Super administrators can view the list of pending requests
- Super administrators can approve or reject requests
- When approved, the user becomes a regular administrator

**Administrator Grades**
- There are two grades: regular administrator and super administrator
- Super administrators can promote regular administrators to super administrator
- Super administrators can demote other super administrators to regular administrator
- Super administrators cannot demote themselves

**Seller Management**
- Administrators can view the list of pending seller approvals
- Administrators can approve or reject seller registrations
- When rejecting, administrators must provide a reason
- Rejected sellers can submit a new registration request
- Administrators can suspend seller accounts
- When a seller is suspended:
  - Their products are hidden from search and category listings
  - Their products cannot be purchased
  - They can still process existing orders (ship items, respond to cancellation/refund requests)
  - They cannot create new products or edit existing products
- Administrators can unsuspend seller accounts (products become visible again)

**Category Management**
- Administrators can create categories and subcategories
- Administrators can edit category names and descriptions
- Administrators can delete categories (products in deleted categories become uncategorized)

**Product Oversight**
- Administrators can view all products on the platform
- Administrators can view snapshots of any product
- Administrators can delete any product (for policy violations)

**Order Oversight**
- Administrators can view all orders on the platform
- Administrators can force-cancel individual items or entire orders (refunds the customer, restores stock)
- Administrators can force-refund individual items or entire orders

**User Management**
- Administrators can view all customer accounts
- Administrators can ban customers (banned customers cannot log in)
- Administrators can unban customers
- Administrators can view all seller accounts
- Administrators can ban sellers (banned sellers cannot log in, existing orders remain)

models.name: shopping_mall_customers
models.description: Registered customer accounts with authentication credentials and profile information. Each customer has a unique email for login, a securely hashed password, and optional profile fields including display name and phone number. Accounts support soft deletion via deleted_at field to preserve historical data.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address used for customer login and communication.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Securely hashed password for customer authentication.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Customer's display name for personalization.

plainFields.name: phone_number
plainFields.description: Customer's phone number for contact purposes.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was soft deleted, if applicable.

models.name: shopping_mall_customer_sessions
models.description: JWT session tokens for customer authentication and session management. Each session stores IP, referer, and URL data for auditing login activities and security. Sessions belong to customers via foreign key relation.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the login client.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL of the current page or endpoint the client accessed.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer from the client's request headers.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp for security.

models.name: shopping_mall_customer_password_resets
models.description: Stores password reset tokens for customer accounts. These tokens allow customers to reset their passwords securely within an expiration window. Each token is unique and references its associated customer account. Expired tokens are invalidated and cleaned up via soft delete.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique secure token for password reset requests.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Datetime when this reset token expires.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the reset token was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the reset token was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp; null if not deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_customer_email_verifications
models.description: Email verification tokens for customers confirming email ownership. Stores unique verification tokens, expiration dates, and verification status to manage and track customer email verification requests. Linked to the customer's main account record with a foreign key relationship to shopping_mall_customers.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique verification token value used in email confirmation links to verify customer's email address.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Expiration datetime of the verification token to enforce time-limited validity.

plainFields.name: verified_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the email was successfully verified. Null if not yet verified.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp for audit and historical tracking.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp for sync and concurrency control.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp marking record as logically deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_sellers
models.description:
Registered seller accounts with authentication credentials and profile including approval status.

This table stores the core information for sellers who register to sell products on the platform. It holds authentication fields (email, password), seller's shop profile (name, description, logo URI), and approval status required for seller activation.

Related child tables include sessions, password resets, email verifications, approval and suspension records handled separately.

This table uses soft delete to preserve historical data while allowing logical removal of sellers.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address used for seller authentication.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Password hash for secure authentication storage.

plainFields.name: shop_name
plainFields.description: Name of the seller's shop, displayed to customers.

plainFields.name: shop_description
plainFields.description: Optional descriptive text about the seller's shop.

plainFields.name: logo_uri
plainFields.description: Optional URI pointing to the seller's shop logo image.

plainFields.name: approval_status
plainFields.description: Current approval status of the seller registration. One of: pending, approved, rejected.

plainFields.name: rejection_reason
plainFields.description: Reason provided by administrators for rejecting the seller's registration.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for soft deletion; null means active.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_sessions
models.description: Stores JWT session tokens for seller authentication and session management, including connection metadata and expiration timestamps. This table enables secure tracking of active seller sessions.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the seller session originated.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL of the page accessed when the session was created.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL indicating the previous page.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires for security.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_email_verifications
models.description: Email verification tokens for sellers confirming email ownership during registration. Supports multiple tokens per seller but each token is unique and has an expiration time to ensure security. Used to verify seller email addresses before allowing full account activation.

foreignFields.name: seller_id
foreignFields.description: The seller who owns this email verification token. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique email verification token string used to confirm seller email ownership.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Expiration datetime of the email verification token.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for when the token was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for when the token was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Optional soft delete timestamp, null if not deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_administrators
models.description: Administrator accounts with elevated privileges and authentication credentials. They have login credentials using email and password hash, are assigned roles with different grades, including super administrator status, and support soft deletion. This table references administrator grades and is central to access control in the system.

foreignFields.name: administrator_grade_id
foreignFields.description: Role and permission grade of the administrator, referencing shopping_mall_administrator_grades.id.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address for administrator login credentials.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for secure authentication.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Full name of the administrator user.

plainFields.name: is_super_admin
plainFields.description: Flag indicating if the administrator has super administrator privileges.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the administrator account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the administrator account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for soft deletion; null if not deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_administrator_sessions
models.description: JWT session tokens for administrator authentication and session management. Tracks sessions including IP address, URL where session was initiated (href), HTTP referrer, creation timestamp, and expiration timestamp. Foreign key 'administrator_id' references shopping_mall_administrators table.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the session was established.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL where the session was initiated or last accessed.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer header string for the session request.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires and is no longer valid.

models.name: shopping_mall_administrator_password_resets
models.description: Password reset tokens with expiration for administrator accounts. Enables secure password reset functionality by storing unique tokens linked to administrators, with expiration for security control.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique token string for password reset authentication.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Expiration timestamp after which the token is invalid.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp of the token record.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp of the token record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp; null if active.

models.name: shopping_mall_administrator_audit_logs
models.description: Audit log records of administrator actions for security and compliance. Each log entry records the administrator responsible, action performed, details including IP address and user agent, and timestamps for creation, update, and soft deletion. This enables thorough tracking and auditing of administrator activities to ensure security and accountability within the system.

foreignFields.name: administrator_id
foreignFields.description: Administrator responsible for the action. {@link shopping_mall_administrators.id}.

plainFields.name: action
plainFields.description: Description of the administrator action performed, such as 'create_user', 'delete_product', 'approve_seller'.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the action including context or additional information.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the administrator performed the action.

plainFields.name: user_agent
plainFields.description: User agent string of the administrator's browser or client application.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the audit log entry was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the audit log entry was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for soft deletion; null if not deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_password_resets
models.description: Password reset tokens for sellers to securely manage password recovery processes. Each record holds a unique token, creation timestamp, expiration timestamp, optional usage timestamp, soft delete timestamp, and is linked to a seller account.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique token string for password reset verification.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the reset token was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the reset token expires.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the reset token was used; null if unused.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp; null if not deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_profile_snapshots
models.description: Immutable snapshots recording seller profile changes over time for audit and dispute resolution. Each record preserves the seller's shop name, shop description, and logo image URL at the time of snapshot, associated with the seller via foreign key shopping_mall_seller_id.

plainFields.name: shop_name

plainFields.name: shop_description

plainFields.name: logo_image_url

models.name: shopping_mall_order_item_snapshots
models.description: Immutable snapshots preserving order item state including product, variant, and seller data at the time of purchase to ensure accurate historical records for audits, disputes, and legal compliance. plainFields.name: seller_logo_uri
plainFields.description: URI of the seller's logo image at the time of purchase; nullable if no logo.

plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.name: updated_at

plainFields.name: snapshot_created_at

plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.name: shopping_mall_system_versions
models.description: Versioning records tracking changes and update history of critical system entities. This table maintains an immutable audit log of entity versions, including fields changed, version sequence, and timestamp information. It supports rollback and historical inspection of system data changes.

plainFields.name: entity_name
plainFields.description: Name of the entity being versioned, e.g., 'shopping_mall_sellers'.

plainFields.name: entity_id
plainFields.description: The UUID of the entity instance being versioned.

plainFields.name: version_number
plainFields.description: Sequential version number for this entity's changes.

plainFields.name: changed_fields
plainFields.description: JSON string listing fields changed in this version.

plainFields.name: change_description
plainFields.description: Optional textual description of the change.

plainFields.name: changed_by
plainFields.description: Identifier of the actor who made the change, e.g., user email or admin ID.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp, null if not deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_audit_logs
models.description: Audit log records capturing system events, user actions, and system changes for security and compliance purposes. Each entry stores details about the event type, actor information, IP address, user agent, metadata as JSON string, and timestamps for creation and updates.

plainFields.name: event_type
plainFields.description: Type of the event being logged (e.g., 'login', 'order_created', 'product_updated').

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the event or action performed.

plainFields.name: actor_type
plainFields.description: Type of actor who performed the event (e.g., 'customer', 'seller', 'administrator').

plainFields.name: actor_id
plainFields.description: UUID of the actor who performed the event, if applicable.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the event originated.

plainFields.name: user_agent
plainFields.description: User agent string of the client application initiating the event.

plainFields.name: metadata
plainFields.description: JSON string storing additional event metadata for auditing.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the log entry was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the log entry was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the log entry was deleted (soft delete).

models.name: shopping_mall_cancellation_request_snapshots
models.description: Immutable snapshots preserving cancellation request data including reason and status changes for auditing and dispute resolution purposes. Records before-and-after states of cancellation requests on order items. Ensures data immutability and historical traceability. Linked to shopping_mall_cancellation_requests and capturing related timestamps and status values.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Textual reason provided for the cancellation request at the snapshot time.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Status of the cancellation request at the snapshot time, e.g., pending, approved, rejected.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp if the snapshot is logically deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_refund_request_snapshots
models.description: Immutable snapshots preserving refund request data including reason, status, and comments. These records enable audit tracking and dispute resolution by capturing historical states of refund requests without alteration.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the refund request at snapshot time. E.g., 'pending', 'approved', 'rejected'.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Detailed reason provided by customer or seller for the refund request.

plainFields.name: comment
plainFields.description: Optional comments or additional notes related to the refund request snapshot.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the snapshot record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the snapshot record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. Null if not deleted.

plainFields.name: updated_at

plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.name: shopping_mall_product_images
models.description: Images associated with products, supporting multiple images per product and reordering (first as thumbnail). Each image record references a product and contains the image URL, display order, and timestamps for creation, update, and soft deletion.

plainFields.name: display_order

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp; null means active.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_variants

plainFields.name: sku_code
plainFields.description: Unique SKU code per product variant used for inventory and order identification.

plainFields.name: price_override
plainFields.description: Optional price override for this variant, replacing the product base price.

plainFields.name: stock_quantity
plainFields.description: Current stock quantity for the variant, updated through inventory history records.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp, null if not deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_snapshots

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id

plainFields.name: updated_at

models.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_snapshots

plainFields.description: SKU code of the product variant at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: option_values

plainFields.name: price_override
plainFields.description: Price override of the variant at snapshot time; null if none.

### `shopping_mall_customers`

Registered customer accounts with authentication credentials and profile
information. Each customer has a unique email for login, a securely
hashed password, and optional profile fields including display name and
phone number. Accounts support soft deletion via deleted_at field to
preserve historical data.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `email`: Unique email address used for customer login and communication.
- `password_hash`: Securely hashed password for customer authentication.
- `display_name`: Customer's display name for personalization.
- `phone_number`: Customer's phone number for contact purposes.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the customer account was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp when the customer account was last updated.
- `deleted_at`: Timestamp when the customer account was soft deleted, if applicable.

### `shopping_mall_customer_sessions`

JWT session tokens for customer authentication and session management.
Each session stores IP, referer, and URL data for auditing login
activities and security. Sessions belong to customers via foreign key
relation.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_customer_id`: Belonged customer's [shopping_mall_customers.id](#shopping_mall_customers).
- `ip`: IP address of the login client.
- `href`: URL of the current page or endpoint the client accessed.
- `referrer`: HTTP referrer from the client's request headers.
- `created_at`: Session creation timestamp.
- `expired_at`: Session expiration timestamp for security.

### `shopping_mall_customer_password_resets`

Stores password reset tokens for customer accounts. These tokens allow
customers to reset their passwords securely within an expiration window.
Each token is unique and references its associated customer account.
Expired tokens are invalidated and cleaned up via soft delete.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_customer_id`: Associated customer's [shopping_mall_customers.id](#shopping_mall_customers).
- `token`: Unique secure token for password reset requests.
- `expired_at`: Datetime when this reset token expires.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the reset token was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp when the reset token was last updated.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp; null if not deleted.

### `shopping_mall_customer_email_verifications`

Email verification tokens for customers confirming email ownership.
Stores unique verification tokens, expiration dates, and verification
status to manage and track customer email verification requests. Linked
to the customer's main account record with a foreign key relationship to
shopping_mall_customers.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_customer_id`: Belonged customer's [shopping_mall_customers.id](#shopping_mall_customers).
- `token`
  > Unique verification token value used in email confirmation links to
  > verify customer's email address.
- `expires_at`
  > Expiration datetime of the verification token to enforce time-limited
  > validity.
- `verified_at`
  > Timestamp when the email was successfully verified. Null if not yet
  > verified.
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp for audit and historical tracking.
- `updated_at`: Record last update timestamp for sync and concurrency control.
- `deleted_at`: Soft delete timestamp marking record as logically deleted.

### `shopping_mall_sellers`

Registered seller accounts with authentication credentials and profile
including approval status.

This table stores the core information for sellers who register to sell
products on the platform. It holds authentication fields (email,
password), seller's shop profile (name, description, logo URI), and
approval status required for seller activation.

Related child tables include sessions, password resets, email
verifications, approval and suspension records handled separately.

This table uses soft delete to preserve historical data while allowing
logical removal of sellers.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `email`: Unique email address used for seller authentication.
- `password_hash`: Password hash for secure authentication storage.
- `shop_name`: Name of the seller's shop, displayed to customers.
- `shop_description`: Optional descriptive text about the seller's shop.
- `logo_uri`: Optional URI pointing to the seller's shop logo image.
- `approval_status`
  > Current approval status of the seller registration. One of: pending,
  > approved, rejected.
- `rejection_reason`: Reason provided by administrators for rejecting the seller's registration.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the seller account was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp when the seller account was last updated.
- `deleted_at`: Timestamp for soft deletion; null means active.

### `shopping_mall_seller_sessions`

Stores JWT session tokens for seller authentication and session
management, including connection metadata and expiration timestamps. This
table enables secure tracking of active seller sessions.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `seller_id`: Belongs to seller's [shopping_mall_sellers.id](#shopping_mall_sellers).
- `ip`: IP address from which the seller session originated.
- `href`: URL of the page accessed when the session was created.
- `referrer`: Referrer URL indicating the previous page.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the session was created.
- `expired_at`: Timestamp when the session expires for security.

### `shopping_mall_seller_email_verifications`

Email verification tokens for sellers confirming email ownership during
registration. Supports multiple tokens per seller but each token is
unique and has an expiration time to ensure security. Used to verify
seller email addresses before allowing full account activation.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `seller_id`
  > The seller who owns this email verification token. {@link
  > shopping_mall_sellers.id}
- `token`
  > Unique email verification token string used to confirm seller email
  > ownership.
- `expired_at`: Expiration datetime of the email verification token.
- `created_at`: Timestamp for when the token was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp for when the token was last updated.
- `deleted_at`: Optional soft delete timestamp, null if not deleted.

### `shopping_mall_administrators`

Administrator accounts with elevated privileges and authentication
credentials. They have login credentials using email and password hash,
are assigned roles with different grades, including super administrator
status, and support soft deletion. This table references administrator
grades and is central to access control in the system.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `administrator_grade_id`
  > Role and permission grade of the administrator, referencing
  > shopping_mall_administrator_grades.id.
- `email`: Unique email address for administrator login credentials.
- `password_hash`: Hashed password for secure authentication.
- `name`: Full name of the administrator user.
- `is_super_admin`: Flag indicating if the administrator has super administrator privileges.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the administrator account was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp when the administrator account was last updated.
- `deleted_at`: Timestamp for soft deletion; null if not deleted.

### `shopping_mall_administrator_sessions`

JWT session tokens for administrator authentication and session
management. Tracks sessions including IP address, URL where session was
initiated (href), HTTP referrer, creation timestamp, and expiration
timestamp. Foreign key 'administrator_id' references
shopping_mall_administrators table.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `administrator_id`: Belonged administrator account's [shopping_mall_administrators.id](#shopping_mall_administrators).
- `ip`: IP address from which the session was established.
- `href`: URL where the session was initiated or last accessed.
- `referrer`: HTTP referrer header string for the session request.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the session was created.
- `expired_at`: Timestamp when the session expires and is no longer valid.

### `shopping_mall_administrator_password_resets`

Password reset tokens with expiration for administrator accounts. Enables
secure password reset functionality by storing unique tokens linked to
administrators, with expiration for security control.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `administrator_id`: Belonged administrator's [shopping_mall_administrators.id](#shopping_mall_administrators).
- `token`: Unique token string for password reset authentication.
- `expired_at`: Expiration timestamp after which the token is invalid.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp of the token record.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp of the token record.
- `deleted_at`: Soft delete timestamp; null if active.

### `shopping_mall_administrator_audit_logs`

Audit log records of administrator actions for security and compliance.
Each log entry records the administrator responsible, action performed,
details including IP address and user agent, and timestamps for creation,
update, and soft deletion. This enables thorough tracking and auditing of
administrator activities to ensure security and accountability within the
system.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `administrator_id`
  > Administrator responsible for the action. {@link
  > shopping_mall_administrators.id}.
- `action`
  > Description of the administrator action performed, such as 'create_user',
  > 'delete_product', 'approve_seller'.
- `description`
  > Detailed description of the action including context or additional
  > information.
- `ip`: IP address from which the administrator performed the action.
- `user_agent`: User agent string of the administrator's browser or client application.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the audit log entry was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp when the audit log entry was last updated.
- `deleted_at`: Timestamp for soft deletion; null if not deleted.

### `shopping_mall_seller_password_resets`

Password reset tokens for sellers to securely manage password recovery
processes. Each record holds a unique token, creation timestamp,
expiration timestamp, optional usage timestamp, soft delete timestamp,
and is linked to a seller account.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `seller_id`: Referenced seller's [shopping_mall_sellers.id](#shopping_mall_sellers).
- `token`: Unique token string for password reset verification.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the reset token was created.
- `expired_at`: Timestamp when the reset token expires.
- `used_at`: Timestamp when the reset token was used; null if unused.
- `deleted_at`: Soft delete timestamp; null if not deleted.

### `shopping_mall_seller_profile_snapshots`

Immutable snapshots recording seller profile changes over time for audit
and dispute resolution. Each record preserves the seller's shop name,
shop description, and logo image URL at the time of snapshot, associated
with the seller via foreign key shopping_mall_seller_id.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_seller_id`: Referenced seller's [shopping_mall_sellers.id](#shopping_mall_sellers).
- `shop_name`: Seller's shop name at the time of snapshot.
- `shop_description`: Seller's shop description at the time of snapshot.
- `logo_image_url`
  > URL of the seller's logo image at the time of snapshot. Nullable if no
  > logo.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the snapshot was created.

### `shopping_mall_order_item_snapshots`

Immutable snapshots preserving order item state including product,
variant, and seller data at the time of purchase to ensure accurate
historical records for audits, disputes, and legal compliance. Each
snapshot records the full state of the order item including product name,
SKU, pricing, quantity, status, and associated seller profile details.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_order_item_id`: Referenced order item. [shopping_mall_order_items.id](#shopping_mall_order_items).
- `shopping_mall_order_id`: Referenced order. [shopping_mall_orders.id](#shopping_mall_orders).
- `product_name`: Product name at the time of purchase.
- `variant_sku`: SKU code of the product variant at purchase time.
- `variant_option_values`: Serialized option values of the variant at purchase time.
- `unit_price`: Price per unit of the product variant at purchase time.
- `quantity`: Quantity purchased in the order item.
- `item_status`
  > Status of the order item at the time of snapshot (e.g., paid, shipped,
  > delivered).
- `seller_shop_name`: Name of the seller's shop at the time of purchase.
- `seller_logo_uri`
  > URI of the seller's logo image at the time of purchase; nullable if no
  > logo.
- `created_at`: Snapshot creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp of the snapshot.
- `deleted_at`: Soft delete timestamp for snapshot record; nullable.

### `shopping_mall_review_snapshots`

Immutable snapshots capturing customer reviews including rating and
content changes for audit and dispute resolution. Each record stores the
state of a customer review at a specific point in time, preserving
historical changes immutably.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_product_review_id`
  > Referenced customer product review's {@link
  > shopping_mall_product_reviews.id}.
- `rating`: Customer rating value from 1 to 5 stars.
- `body`: Review textual content; nullable if customer only rated without text.
- `snapshot_created_at`: Timestamp when the snapshot was created.
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Record last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Record soft delete timestamp for logical deletion.

### `shopping_mall_system_settings`

System-wide configuration settings for platform behavior and parameters.
Stores key-value configuration options for the e-commerce platform,
including metadata for description and data type. Supports soft deletion
for safe configuration changes.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `key`: Unique key identifier for the system setting.
- `value`: Value of the setting stored as a string.
- `description`: Human-readable description of the setting's purpose and usage.
- `data_type`: Data type of the setting value (e.g., string, int, boolean, json).
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Record last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp, null if active.

### `shopping_mall_system_versions`

Versioning records tracking changes and update history of critical system
entities. This table maintains an immutable audit log of entity versions,
including fields changed, version sequence, and timestamp information. It
supports rollback and historical inspection of system data changes.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `entity_name`: Name of the entity being versioned, e.g., 'shopping_mall_sellers'.
- `entity_id`: The UUID of the entity instance being versioned.
- `version_number`: Sequential version number for this entity's changes.
- `changed_fields`: JSON string listing fields changed in this version.
- `change_description`: Optional textual description of the change.
- `changed_by`: Identifier of the actor who made the change, e.g., user email or admin ID.
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Record last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft delete timestamp, null if not deleted.

### `shopping_mall_audit_logs`

Audit log records capturing system events, user actions, and system
changes for security and compliance purposes. Each entry stores details
about the event type, actor information, IP address, user agent, metadata
as JSON string, and timestamps for creation and updates.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `event_type`
  > Type of the event being logged (e.g., 'login', 'order_created',
  > 'product_updated').
- `description`: Detailed description of the event or action performed.
- `actor_type`
  > Type of actor who performed the event (e.g., 'customer', 'seller',
  > 'administrator').
- `actor_id`: UUID of the actor who performed the event, if applicable.
- `ip`: IP address from which the event originated.
- `user_agent`: User agent string of the client application initiating the event.
- `metadata`: JSON string storing additional event metadata for auditing.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the log entry was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp when the log entry was last updated.
- `deleted_at`: Timestamp when the log entry was deleted (soft delete).

### `shopping_mall_cancellation_request_snapshots`

Immutable snapshots preserving cancellation request data including reason
and status changes for auditing and dispute resolution purposes. Records
before-and-after states of cancellation requests on order items. Ensures
data immutability and historical traceability. Linked to
shopping_mall_cancellation_requests and capturing related timestamps and
status values.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `cancellation_request_id`
  > Belonged cancellation request's {@link
  > shopping_mall_cancellation_requests.id}.
- `reason`: Textual reason provided for the cancellation request at the snapshot time.
- `status`
  > Status of the cancellation request at the snapshot time, e.g., pending,
  > approved, rejected.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when this snapshot record was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp when this snapshot record was last updated.
- `deleted_at`: Soft delete timestamp if the snapshot is logically deleted.

### `shopping_mall_refund_request_snapshots`

Immutable snapshots preserving refund request data including reason,
status, and comments. These records enable audit tracking and dispute
resolution by capturing historical states of refund requests without
alteration.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_refund_request_id`: Belonged refund request's [shopping_mall_refund_requests.id](#shopping_mall_refund_requests).
- `status`
  > Current status of the refund request at snapshot time. E.g., 'pending',
  > 'approved', 'rejected'.
- `reason`: Detailed reason provided by customer or seller for the refund request.
- `comment`
  > Optional comments or additional notes related to the refund request
  > snapshot.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the snapshot record was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp when the snapshot record was last updated.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp. Null if not deleted.

### `shopping_mall_categories`

Categories organizing products with optional single-level subcategories
for hierarchical browsing and filtering. Supports hierarchical
parent-child relationships for categories and subcategories.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `parent_category_id`
  > Parent category's [shopping_mall_categories.id](#shopping_mall_categories). Nullable for
  > top-level categories.
- `name`: Name of the category.
- `description`: Description of the category.
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Record last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft delete timestamp. Null if not deleted.

### `shopping_mall_products`

Products created by sellers with details like name, description, base
price, belonging to specific product subcategories and sellers. Supports
soft deletion for safe removal without losing history.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `seller_id`: The seller who owns this product. References shopping_mall_sellers.id.
- `product_subcategory_id`
  > The subcategory this product belongs to. References
  > shopping_mall_product_subcategories.id.
- `name`: The product's name identifying it in listings and searches.
- `description`: Detailed description of the product, explaining features and attributes.
- `base_price`: The base price before any variant overrides.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the product was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp when the product was last updated.
- `deleted_at`: Timestamp when the product was soft-deleted. Null means active.

### `shopping_mall_product_images`

Images associated with products, supporting multiple images per product
and reordering (first as thumbnail). Each image record references a
product and contains the image URL, display order, and timestamps for
creation, update, and soft deletion.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_product_id`: Referenced product's [shopping_mall_products.id](#shopping_mall_products).
- `image_url`: URL of the product image.
- `display_order`
  > Ordering index to determine the display sequence of images for a product.
  > The lowest value is the thumbnail.
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Record last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp; null means active.

### `shopping_mall_product_variants`

Variants (SKUs) of products representing option combinations with SKU
code, price override, and stock quantity. Each variant belongs to a
single product, storing unique SKU codes per product and optional price
overrides. Includes timestamps for creation, update, and soft deletion.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_product_id`: Belonged product's [shopping_mall_products.id](#shopping_mall_products).
- `sku_code`
  > Unique SKU code per product variant used for inventory and order
  > identification.
- `price_override`
  > Optional price override for this variant, replacing the product base
  > price.
- `stock_quantity`
  > Current stock quantity for the variant, updated through inventory history
  > records.
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Record last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp, null if not deleted.

### `shopping_mall_product_snapshots`

Immutable snapshots capturing product states at edit time including
embedded variant snapshots, preserving historical states. Each record
stores a complete snapshot of a product's data at a point in time for
audit and dispute resolution.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_product_id`
  > The original product's [shopping_mall_products.id](#shopping_mall_products) that this
  > snapshot belongs to.
- `name`: Snapshot of the product name at the time of this snapshot.
- `description`: Snapshot of the product description at the time of this snapshot.
- `category_id`
  > FK to the product's snapshot category [shopping_mall_categories.id](#shopping_mall_categories)
  > at snapshot time.
- `base_price`: Snapshot of the product's base price at the time of this snapshot.
- `deleted_at`
  > Timestamp indicating when this snapshot record was logically deleted, if
  > applicable.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when this snapshot was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp when this snapshot was last updated.

### `shopping_mall_product_variant_snapshots`

Immutable snapshots capturing individual variant states at edit time to
preserve audit trail of SKU changes. Stores SKU code, option values,
price override, stock quantity, and created timestamp. Linked to the
shopping_mall_product_variants parent for audit and historical tracking.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_product_variant_id`: Belonged product variant's [shopping_mall_product_variants.id](#shopping_mall_product_variants).
- `sku_code`: SKU code of the product variant at snapshot time.
- `option_values`: Serialized JSON string of variant option values at snapshot time.
- `price_override`: Price override of the variant at snapshot time; null if none.
- `stock_quantity`: Stock quantity of the variant at snapshot time.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the snapshot was created.

### `shopping_mall_sales`

Main product sale listings containing details, pricing, and their
relationship to sellers and product categories. Represents products
available for sale by sellers in the e-commerce platform. Supports status
for approval workflow and soft deletion for logical removal.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `seller_id`: The seller who owns this sale listing. [shopping_mall_sellers.id](#shopping_mall_sellers).
- `category_id`
  > The category this sale belongs to. {@link
  > shopping_mall_product_categories.id}.
- `name`: The product name for display and search.
- `description`: Detailed product description.
- `base_price`: Base price of the product.
- `status`
  > Status of the sale listing, e.g., pending approval, approved, rejected,
  > or inactive.
- `created_at`: The creation timestamp of this sale listing.
- `updated_at`: The last update timestamp of this sale listing.
- `deleted_at`: Timestamp indicating logical deletion.

### `shopping_mall_sale_snapshots`

Immutable snapshots capturing historical states of sales listings for
audit and dispute resolution. This table preserves all sale attributes
exactly as they were at the moment of snapshot creation, including
references to the original sale entity.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_sale_id`: Reference to the original sale's [shopping_mall_sales.id](#shopping_mall_sales).
- `title`: Snapshot of the sale's title.
- `description`: Snapshot of the sale's detailed description.
- `category_id`: Snapshot of the category id [shopping_mall_categories.id](#shopping_mall_categories).
- `base_price`: Snapshot of the base price of the sale.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when this snapshot was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp when this snapshot was last updated.
- `deleted_at`
  > Nullable timestamp for soft deletion; usually null as snapshots are
  > immutable.

### `shopping_mall_sale_units`

Individual product variant units within each sale, capturing SKU codes,
option values, and optional price overrides. Linked to the parent sale
entity in shopping_mall_sales to represent variant listings of the
product for sale.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_sale_id`
  > Parent sale reference. Links this unit to its sale listing in
  > shopping_mall_sales. [shopping_mall_sales.id](#shopping_mall_sales).
- `sku_code`
  > SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) code uniquely identifying this variant within
  > the sale.
- `option_values`: Option values representing variant attributes serialized as a JSON string.
- `price_override`
  > Optional price override for this variant, if different from the base sale
  > price.
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Record last updated timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft delete timestamp, if the record is deleted.

### `shopping_mall_sale_unit_snapshots`

Immutable snapshots preserving states of sale units at each change event
for audit and dispute resolution. Each record duplicates all relevant
fields from the sale unit exactly at that snapshot event, with foreign
keys to the sale unit and to the parent sale snapshot for full history
capture.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_sale_unit_id`
  > The linked sale unit which this snapshot represents. {@link
  > shopping_mall_sale_units.id}
- `shopping_mall_sale_snapshot_id`
  > The parent sale snapshot that groups this sale unit snapshot. {@link
  > shopping_mall_sale_snapshots.id}
- `sku_code`: SKU code at the moment of snapshot.
- `option_values`: Option values of the sale unit at snapshot time.
- `price_override`: Optional price override at snapshot time.
- `stock_quantity`: Stock quantity at snapshot time.
- `is_active`: Whether the sale unit was active at snapshot time.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when this snapshot record was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp when this snapshot record was last updated.
- `deleted_at`: Timestamp indicating soft deletion, if any.

### `shopping_mall_sale_images`

Images associated with each sale in the shopping mall platform,
supporting multiple images per sale and allowing ordering and alt text
for accessibility. Each image is linked to a single sale listing.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_sale_id`: Reference to the owning sale's [shopping_mall_sales.id](#shopping_mall_sales).
- `image_url`: URL of the sale image.
- `display_order`: Order of the image within the sale's image list, starting from 1.
- `alt_text`
  > Alternative text description for the image, used for accessibility and
  > SEO.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the record was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp when the record was last updated.
- `deleted_at`: Timestamp when the record was soft-deleted; null if active.

### `shopping_mall_sale_specifications`

Technical specifications and detailed attributes for each sale. Provides
extended product specification information linked to sales, enabling
precise detail management for products listed on the shopping mall
platform. References the main sale entity [shopping_mall_sales.id](#shopping_mall_sales)
for contextual association.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_sale_id`: Related sale entity's [shopping_mall_sales.id](#shopping_mall_sales).
- `specification_key`
  > Key name for the technical specification attribute, e.g., 'Weight',
  > 'Material', 'Battery Life'.
- `specification_value`
  > Value corresponding to the specification_key, describing the technical
  > detail.
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Record last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp, null if not deleted.

### `shopping_mall_sale_reviews`

Customer reviews and ratings for sales (products), including star ratings
and optional textual feedback. Each review is linked to a specific sale
and customer for ownership and traceability. Supports soft deletion for
review moderation and historical record keeping.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_sale_id`: Referenced sale entity's [shopping_mall_sales.id](#shopping_mall_sales).
- `shopping_mall_customer_id`: Authoring customer [shopping_mall_customers.id](#shopping_mall_customers).
- `rating`: Star rating given by the customer, integer between 1 and 5.
- `body`: Optional textual content of the review.
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Record last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp; null if not deleted.

### `shopping_mall_sale_review_votes`

Helpful votes on customer reviews indicating their usefulness.

Stores who voted on which review and when. Supports polymorphic ownership
by actor type (customer or seller). Maintains soft delete status to
preserve vote history.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_product_review_id`: Target review's [shopping_mall_product_reviews.id](#shopping_mall_product_reviews).
- `voter_id`
  > Voter's [shopping_mall_customers.id](#shopping_mall_customers) or {@link
  > shopping_mall_sellers.id} depending on actor_type.
- `actor_type`: Actor type of the voter: either 'customer' or 'seller'.
- `created_at`: Timestamp of when the vote was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp of when the vote was last updated.
- `deleted_at`: Timestamp of soft deletion. Null if not deleted.

### `shopping_mall_sale_questions`

Customer questions regarding sales, facilitating pre-purchase inquiries
and interactions with sellers. Stores question content, references to
sale and customer, and timestamps for lifecycle tracking.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_sale_id`: Referenced sale item's [shopping_mall_sales.id](#shopping_mall_sales).
- `shopping_mall_customer_id`: Authoring customer's [shopping_mall_customers.id](#shopping_mall_customers).
- `title`: Question title summarizing customer inquiry.
- `body`: Detailed question content written by the customer.
- `status`
  > Current status of the question (e.g., 'open', 'closed', 'answered',
  > 'pending'). Usually managed by system or seller responses.
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft delete timestamp for deactivated questions.

### `shopping_mall_sale_favorites`

Customer wishlist favorites for sales, tracking user preferences. Links
customers to sales items they have favorited, enabling wishlist
functionality.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_customer_id`: Belonged customer's [shopping_mall_customers.id](#shopping_mall_customers).
- `shopping_mall_sale_id`: Favorited sale item [shopping_mall_sales.id](#shopping_mall_sales).
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Record last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Record soft deletion timestamp.

### `shopping_mall_sale_promotions`

Promotions and discounts applied to sales for marketing and pricing
strategies. This table records all active and historical promotions
assigned to sales items, including discount details, validity periods,
and promotional codes. Each promotion is linked to a specific sale in the
[shopping_mall_sales](#shopping_mall_sales) table. Maintaining these records enables
flexible marketing strategies and accurate pricing calculations.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_sale_id`: Associated sale's [shopping_mall_sales.id](#shopping_mall_sales).
- `promotion_code`: Optional promotional code for discount application.
- `promotion_type`
  > Type of promotion (e.g., percentage discount, fixed amount discount, free
  > shipping).
- `description`: Detailed description of the promotion.
- `discount_value`: Value of the discount, interpreted according to discount_type.
- `discount_type`: Specifies if discount_value is a percentage or a fixed amount.
- `start_at`: Start datetime for the promotion's validity period.
- `end_at`: End datetime for the promotion's validity period.
- `active`: Indicates whether the promotion is currently active.
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Record last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp, null if not deleted.

### `shopping_mall_sale_view_stats`

Analytics capturing view statistics for sales to understand customer
interest and behavior. This table stores aggregated counts of views and
unique user views per sale entity, supporting business intelligence and
marketing analysis.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_sale_id`: Referenced sale entity's [shopping_mall_sales.id](#shopping_mall_sales).
- `view_count`: Total number of views recorded for the sale.
- `unique_view_count`: Number of unique users who viewed the sale.
- `first_viewed_at`: Timestamp when the sale was first viewed.
- `last_viewed_at`: Timestamp when the sale was last viewed.
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Record update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft delete timestamp if the record is soft deleted.

### `shopping_mall_sale_question_answers`

Seller answers to customer questions, supporting a mandatory one-to-one
relationship with shopping_mall_sale_questions. Each answer has a title
and body provided by the seller, linking uniquely to a question. Includes
reference to the seller who answered and standard audit timestamps with
soft delete support.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_sale_question_id`
  > Referenced question's [shopping_mall_sale_questions.id](#shopping_mall_sale_questions) enforcing
  > one-to-one relation.
- `seller_id`
  > Belonging seller's [shopping_mall_sellers.id](#shopping_mall_sellers) who answered the
  > question.
- `title`: Answer title provided by the seller.
- `body`: Detailed answer content from the seller.
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Record last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft delete timestamp; null if not deleted.

### `shopping_mall_orders`

Customer orders with aggregated details including total price, quantity,
payment status, and overall order state. Links to customers placing
orders and supports soft delete for historical record keeping.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_customer_id`: The customer who placed this order. [shopping_mall_customers.id](#shopping_mall_customers)
- `order_number`: Unique order number for public reference and tracking.
- `total_price`: Total amount payable for the order.
- `total_quantity`: Total quantity of all items in the order.
- `order_status`
  > Overall status of the order: paid, shipped, delivered, cancelled,
  > refunded, partially_completed.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the order was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp when the order was last updated.
- `deleted_at`: Soft delete timestamp allowing for historical record keeping.

### `shopping_mall_order_items`

Individual order items representing product variants within a customer
order, including status tracking, quantity, and linkage to related
entities. Each item is uniquely identified and associated with one order
and one product variant, supporting lifecycle management and operational
workflows.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_order_id`: The parent order containing this item. [shopping_mall_orders.id](#shopping_mall_orders)
- `shopping_mall_product_variant_id`
  > The product variant purchased in this order item. {@link
  > shopping_mall_product_variants.id}
- `quantity`: Quantity of the product variant ordered for this item.
- `status`
  > Current status of the order item: paid, shipped, delivered, cancelled,
  > refunded.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the order item record was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp when the order item record was last updated.
- `deleted_at`: Timestamp marking soft deletion of the order item, if applicable.

### `shopping_mall_shipment_items`

Mapping of which order items are included in shipments. Each record
associates a specific order item with a shipment to accurately track
shipment contents and enable delivery tracking.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shipment_id`
  > Referenced shipment's [shopping_mall_shipments.id](#shopping_mall_shipments) this item
  > belongs to.
- `order_item_id`
  > Referenced order item [shopping_mall_order_items.id](#shopping_mall_order_items) included in
  > this shipment.
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last record update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp, nullable.

### `shopping_mall_cancellation_requests`

Customer requests to cancel specific order items with seller approval
status and processing workflow. Records customer, order item, reason,
seller approval status, optional reason, timestamps for request creation
and processing, facilitating management of cancellation requests
independently by customers and sellers.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_customer_id`: Requesting customer's [shopping_mall_customers.id](#shopping_mall_customers).
- `shopping_mall_order_item_id`
  > Order item requested for cancellation {@link
  > shopping_mall_order_items.id}.
- `reason`: Textual reason the customer provides for requesting cancellation.
- `seller_approval_status`
  > Seller's approval status for the cancellation request (e.g., 'pending',
  > 'approved', 'rejected').
- `seller_approval_reason`: Optional text explaining the seller's rejection or approval reason.
- `requested_at`: Timestamp when the cancellation request was made.
- `processed_at`: Timestamp of when the seller processed the request (approved/rejected).
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp for the cancellation request record.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp for the cancellation request record.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp; null if not deleted.

### `shopping_mall_refund_requests`

Customer refund requests for delivered order items including seller
approval status, reasons, and timestamps for request and response. Tracks
refund workflow status and supports soft deletion.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_order_item_id`: Referenced order item [shopping_mall_order_items.id](#shopping_mall_order_items).
- `shopping_mall_customer_id`: Requesting customer [shopping_mall_customers.id](#shopping_mall_customers).
- `shopping_mall_seller_id`: Seller receiving the refund request [shopping_mall_sellers.id](#shopping_mall_sellers).
- `request_reason`: Reason provided by the customer for the refund request.
- `status`: Status of the refund request (e.g., pending, approved, rejected).
- `seller_response_reason`: Reason provided by the seller in response to the refund request.
- `requested_at`: Timestamp when the refund was requested by the customer.
- `responded_at`: Timestamp when the seller responded to the refund request.
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Record last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Record soft deletion timestamp; null if not deleted.

### `shopping_mall_order_snapshots`

Immutable snapshots of customer orders capturing the complete state of
each order at a specific point in time for audit, dispute resolution, and
historical reference. This includes denormalized data of the original
order, customer details, order items, and status.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `shopping_mall_order_id`: Referenced original order's shopping_mall_orders.id.
- `snapshot_at`: Timestamp when the snapshot was created.
- `status`
  > Current status of the order in this snapshot (e.g., paid, shipped,
  > delivered).
- `total_price`: Total price of the order at snapshot time.
- `customer_name`: Denormalized customer name at snapshot time.
- `customer_email`: Denormalized customer email at snapshot time.
- `shipping_address`: Denormalized shipping address in text form at snapshot time.
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Record last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft delete timestamp; null if not deleted.

### `shopping_mall_reviews`

Customer product reviews linked to orders with star ratings and textual
content. Reviews are tied to customers, orders, and specific order items
to ensure verified purchases. Supports rating from 1 to 5 stars, optional
review text, and soft deletion. Maintains historical integrity through
snapshots in a separate component.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `customer_id`: Reviewing customer's [shopping_mall_customers.id](#shopping_mall_customers).
- `order_id`: Associated order [shopping_mall_orders.id](#shopping_mall_orders).
- `order_item_id`: Specific order item reviewed [shopping_mall_order_items.id](#shopping_mall_order_items).
- `rating`: Star rating given by the customer, between 1 and 5.
- `body`: Optional textual content of the review.
- `created_at`: Review creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last review update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft delete timestamp for review removals.
